comments.body:
DECISIONS APPROVED (operator, 2026-07-24) — implementation in progress on worktree 72d9-drift-basis.

1. Comparison basis: signed hashes stay pinned at the review's verified_at_sha; the claim gate re-hashes at a snapshot of the CURRENT gate ref (REBAR_GATE_REF / [snapshot].ref / origin/main), resolved from the local object DB (fetch=False). source=local config or an unresolvable ref degrades to the working tree. Verified this does NOT reintroduce the ADR-0002 false positive: that was whole-HEAD SHA equality; per-path content comparison at the current ref only fires when a signed dependency file's bytes changed. Uncommitted working-tree edits move neither side, so the S4b protection is kept. Root cause note: ADR 0002's S4b addendum itself specified re-hashing 'at the SAME SHA's snapshot — identical by construction'; the consolidation over-corrected and the ADR text is being amended, not just the code.
2. The drift-refresh path (_rehash at the active review snapshot) was already correct and is untouched; only the claim-gate branch changes.
3. Suite default migrates local -> attested/ref=HEAD (salvaged from WIP 5bf846df9), with _commit_all and committed drift in the drift tests.
4. test_ref_coherence.py re-pinned: uncommitted-tree drift still does not invalidate; committed drift in a signed dependency now does; unrelated committed change still does not; local back-out re-expressed as explicit REBAR_GATE_SOURCE=local.

Discovered while testing: the review-plan --help test leaks a .tickets-tracker symlink into a fresh worktree's repo root (pre-existing on main) — filed as dd62-2791-6413-4ae0 (sapient-rutile-penguin), linked discovered_from.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
In ATTESTED mode — the PRODUCTION default (`source=attested`, `ref=origin/main`) — a scoped
plan-review attestation is never invalidated by a change to its own reviewed dependency
files. The claim gate's drift check cannot fire, by construction.

Mechanism (`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/manifest.py:190-225`, `_hash_basis`): the claim gate
re-hashes the signed dependency paths at the signature's PINNED `verified_at_sha`:

    * ``pinned_sha`` given (the claim gate, reading the signature's ``verified_at_sha``) ->
      the materialized snapshot at that SHA

The manifest's hashes were produced from that same pinned snapshot. Re-hashing the same
immutable tree therefore ALWAYS matches, so `drift` is structurally unreachable. Scoping then
suppresses the whole-HEAD staleness fallback (that fallback only applies to an EMPTY dependency
set), so nothing else catches it either — the claim is simply allowed.

Net effect in production: review a plan scoped to `foo.py`, let `foo.py` change on `main`,
and the attestation still satisfies the claim gate. The gate's dependency-drift protection is
inert exactly where it was supposed to matter.

## Why it was invisible
`tests/conftest.py` defaulted the whole offline suite to `source=local`, where the basis is
the MUTABLE working tree, so both sides of the comparison move and drift fires normally. Every
drift test passes against local-mode semantics that production never uses.

Demonstrated by flipping that default to `attested`/`ref=HEAD` (branch
`5128-local-never-signs`): five drift tests fail with the attestation NOT invalidating —
`test_code_drift_in_dependency_file_invalidates` reaches `DID NOT RAISE RebarError`, i.e. the
claim SUCCEEDS after the reviewed file changed and was committed.

Discovered while implementing melancholy-firstborn-shihtzu (5128-0856-d80f-4eb6).

## Complication — a CONFLICTING design authority for 5128
`manifest.py:206-207` states:

    BACK-OUT: a plan-review signed in local mode (or pre-S4b) carries no ``verified_at_sha``;
    both sides then resolve to the working tree exactly as before this consolidation.

That sentence ASSUMES local-mode-signed plan reviews exist and are supported — which
contradicts ADR 0005 / `repo_snapshot.SOURCE_LOCAL` / the CLI help ("local ... never signs"),
the authorities 5128's fix rests on. I did not have this citation when I classified 5128 as an
unambiguous `defect`; it points the other way and must be reconciled before 5128 lands.

There is also an order-of-work dependency: the working tree is the ONLY mutable basis, so
once local-source signing is removed, the mutable-basis path this drift machinery needs is
unreachable through any supported route. Fixing 5128 first would leave the drift subsystem
with no reachable test basis at all.

## Expected Behavior
A scoped attestation must be invalidated when a file in its signed dependency set changes in
the attested basis (i.e. the current gate ref moved and one of those files differs between the
pinned SHA and the current ref), while an UNRELATED change must still not invalidate it (the
worm-folly-barge property that scoping exists to preserve).

## Approach
1. Decide the comparison basis: the drift check should re-hash the dependency set at the
   CURRENT gate ref and compare against the manifest's pinned hashes — not re-hash at the
   pinned SHA, which is a tautology.
2. Preserve the ADR 0002 anti-false-positive property: only the SIGNED dependency paths
   participate, so unrelated commits still do not invalidate.
3. Re-point the drift tests at attested semantics (commit the drift; the suite default move
   is prepared on branch `5128-local-never-signs`).
4. Reconcile the `manifest.py:206-207` back-out sentence with ADR 0005 and record which wins.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/manifest.py`
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py`
- `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_plan_review_gate.py`
- `tests/conftest.py`
- `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, ADR 0002 / ADR 0005 reconciliation

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] With the suite on the attested default, changing a SIGNED dependency file and committing
      it invalidates the attestation: `rebar claim` is blocked and the reason names drift.
- [ ] An UNRELATED committed change still does NOT invalidate a scoped attestation
      (`test_unrelated_change_does_not_invalidate_attestation` stays green).
- [ ] Deleting a signed dependency file invalidates.
- [ ] The drift-refresh path (immaterial drift -> refresh without full re-review) works under
      attested semantics.
- [ ] `manifest.py`'s local-mode back-out comment matches whatever is decided for
      melancholy-firstborn-shihtzu; the two no longer contradict.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and the default non-integration pytest suite exit zero.
compiled_state.title: Scoped plan-review attestations never detect dependency drift in attested mode (production default)
